items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission confirms withdrawal of the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed in November 2026 that it is scrapping and withdrawing the proposed Green Claims Directive.

items.text: Change the stage from Adopted to In force
items.reason: The revised ESRS entered into force on 10 November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Entered into force on 10 November 2026 and apply from financial year 2027; the voluntary standard has been in force since 24 September 2026.”
items.reason: Reflects that the 10 November 2026 entry into force date has passed.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached on boosting free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries”
items.reason: The Council and European Parliament reached a provisional agreement on 12 November 2026 to increase free carbon allowance allocations for energy-intensive industries.

items.text: New status text: “Proposal abandoned following official confirmation by the European Commission in November 2026 that it is withdrawing the draft directive.”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed in November 2026 its intention to withdraw the Green Claims Directive proposal.
